# balena_device_config_variable (Data Source)

Reads the one device config variable (the `device_config_variable` resource of the `/v7` API) that matches every configured attribute. At least one attribute must be set, and exactly one row must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "balena_device_config_variable" "example" {
  id = 123456
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Optional

- `device_id` (Number) ID of the referenced `device` (API field `device`). Changing it replaces the resource. Selects the row when configured.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the device config variable. Selects the row when configured.
- `name` (String) API field `name` (short text). Name rules from the API's /config/vars: must not match `^[\d:]|[^A-Za-z0-9_:]`; must not be `BALENA`, `RESIN`, `USER`; must start with `BALENA_` or `RESIN_`. Changing it replaces the resource. Selects the row when configured.
- `value` (String) API field `value` (text). At most 372340 characters. Selects the row when configured.
